title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 3, section 2 (Tranquille Wildlife Management Area)

source.version: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

source_text:
Schedule 3 No Shooting or Hunting Areas (Section 4)
Tranquille Wildlife Management Area
2 That portion of the Province of British Columbia in the vicinity of the City of Kamloops, KDYD, which is contained within the following described boundaries: Commencing at the northeast corner of Lot 341; thence southerly then easterly following the fence line to the southeast corner of Lot 341 at the low water mark; thence westerly following the shoreline at the low water mark to the southwest corner of the Tranquille Wildlife Management Area on the lakeshore at low water mark; thence northerly and easterly along the western and northern boundary of the Tranquille Wildlife Management Area following the Tranquille and Red Lake road right of way to the point of commencement. [en. B.C. Reg. 205/94, s. 2.]
